bioconda.name: insitugame
bioconda.summary: In situ spatial evolutionary game assay for inferring tumor subclonal payoff matrices and adaptive therapy regimens.
bioconda.description: A computational oncology assay to infer subclonal payoff matrices, solve Nash equilibria, decouple microenvironmental confounders, and simulate adaptive therapy regimens directly from intact spatial transcriptomics biopsies.
